summary.intent: Execute Phase 50 (IPFS/IPNS Data-Integrity Fixes) of the CipherBox project using the GSD manager workflow, running 5 plans in parallel via worktree-isolated subagents across two dependency waves.
summary.outcome: All 5 plans executed and merged successfully (Wave 1: 50-01/02/03/05 in parallel; Wave 2: 50-04). Post-merge build/typecheck and 93 targeted unit tests passed. A deep code review found 2 blockers (cycle guard missing, unhandled promise rejections) and 5 warnings, leaving fix tasks queued at session end.

repo: pnpm/orval resolves to the workspace root (not the active worktree), so running `pnpm api:generate` inside a worktree leaks 131+ api-client files into the main working tree, blocking subsequent merge steps.

Husky regenerates `.husky/_/*` stubs whenever pnpm install or api:generate runs in a worktree, leaving the worktree dirty and causing the cleanup-wave helper to report opaque `merge_failed` before committing.
The `gsd_run query commit` helper has a confirmed false-negative: it reports `commit_failed` but the commit actually lands; always verify with `git log`.

The pre-commit hook runs `check-api-client.sh` + `pnpm lint-staged` (eslint+prettier across ~131 api-client files); the cleanup-wave helper's internal commit silently stalls/fails on this hook because of timeout, requiring manual merge completion.
The manager dashboard dep-string parser mis-parses 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' as phantom phase `1.1`, falsely marking Phase 50 as dep-unsatisfied even though Phase 49 is complete.
macOS BSD `mktemp` does not substitute `XXXXXX` when placed mid-string (e.g., `tmp-XXXXXX-manifest`); suffix-only placement is required.
Two orphaned worktree branches (`worktree-agent-a92edd36`, `worktree-agent-abd7998d`) from a prior session exist with no attached worktrees; they were left untouched to avoid scope creep.

`collectSubtreeIpnsNamesAsync` docstring claims to mirror the `ensureFolderLoaded` DFS pattern but omits the `visited` set that its sibling at line 549 and the shared walker at line 2526 both carry — cycle guard regression introduced in 50-03.

code.finding: CR-01 BLOCKER: `collectSubtreeIpnsNamesAsync` recurses at lines 220, 246, 316 with no `visited` set — folder cycle causes unbounded recursion and `deleteItem` failure. Siblings `ensureFolderLoaded` (line 549) and shared walker (line 2526) both carry a visited set.
CR-02 BLOCKER: 4 fire-and-forget unenroll dispatch sites use `.then()` with no `.catch()`, silently swallowing errors from the cycle-guardless `collectSubtreeIpnsNamesAsync`.
WR-03 fix landed: refcount guard skips physical unpin when CID is re-pinned during drain (50-02).

IN-01 (50-04): `fileUnpins.inc()` now gated by `rowDeleted` flag; IN-06: `outboxRowInserted` renamed to `shouldAttemptPhysicalUnpin`; IN-03: `recordUnpin` deleted (zero callers, 2 spec tests removed).

workflow: When worktree agents leak generated files into the main working tree, verify the leaked files match the expected worktree commits before discarding — `git diff <worktree-branch> -- <file>` confirms identity.
After a merge conflict leaves `MERGE_HEAD` in place (helper's internal commit failed on hooks), completing the merge manually with hooks enabled (`git commit`) is the correct resolution path.
Post-merge gate should use targeted test suites (per-package, changed files only) rather than the full parallel monorepo suite to avoid RAM starvation and infra-dependent integration test failures.

Key-link 'failures' that reference the upcoming wave's own deliverables are forward-reference artifacts from the parser, not real unmet dependencies; confirm by checking if the referenced file exists on HEAD.
Deep code review (13 files) is appropriate up to ~50 files; the workflow auto-degrades to standard above that threshold.

friction: cleanup-wave helper produced opaque `merge_failed` with empty stderr when husky `.husky/_/` stubs left the worktree dirty — required manual diagnosis and workaround (clean stubs, retry).

50-05's `pnpm api:generate` leaked 131 api-client files into the main working tree, blocking the subsequent merge of 50-03; required identifying, verifying, and discarding the leaked copies before re-merging.
50-03's `packages/sdk/src/client.ts` also leaked into the main working tree for the same pnpm workspace-root resolution reason.
cleanup-wave helper's internal pre-commit hook pipeline (eslint+prettier across 131 staged files) silently timed out/failed, leaving MERGE_HEAD in place without an informative error message.
Manager dashboard dependency resolver mis-parsed 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' as phantom phase `1.1`, producing a false 'deps unsatisfied' warning on Phase 50.
`gsd_run query commit` false-negative required `git log` verification on every tracking commit to confirm success.
